svg.text: Route: /admin/users (popup) · Screen: 1280 px wide desktop browser · Access: Admin only (admin site, signed in)
• All four fields are required; the email must be valid and the password at least 8 characters (checked by the browser and again by the API). An API error (e.g. “A user with that email
already exists”) shows above the buttons.
• On success the popup closes and “Account created for Full name (Staff)” appears. No email is sent: the admin gives the temporary password to the person.

g.text: Everything staff can do, plus products, prices and costs, bulk import,
analytics and reports, and user administration.
Orders, counter payment confirmation, kitchen display, and stock
adjustments. No product, price, report, or user administration.
